_doc: Denylist for scripts/leak_guard.py. Private words are stored only as sha256 hashes of lowercase tokens (two tokens are joined by one space), so this public file does not reveal them. Add one with: python scripts/leak_guard.py --hash 'term'. Terms that are too sensitive even as a hash, such as RBAC fixture names, go in the LEAK_GUARD_PRIVATE_TERMS repository secret (comma-separated). CI reads that secret, and nothing in the repo stores it.
